post.summary: Sign in with user name and password (tenant optional; platform accounts leave it empty); returns access and refresh tokens.
Revoke the session of the current token.
Return the current user, tenant, session and roles.
Return the current principal's effective permissions, roles, menu tree and page codes.
Exchange a refresh token for new tokens; the refresh token rotates and the old one stops working.
Switch the current session to another tenant (home tenant or a tenant the user is a member of) or back to the platform (platform accounts only); returns new tokens.

delete.summary: Delete departments in batch; departments that still have children or members are rejected item by item. Requires organization.departments.delete.

post.summary: Create a department anywhere in the tree (code unique within the tenant; parent must exist; leader must be a user of this tenant). Tenant side only; requires organization.departments.create.

get.summary: Get a department with its ancestors, leader user name, child count and member count. Requires organization.departments.read.

put.summary: Update a department's name, leader, order, description and status (the parent is changed with departments.move). Requires organization.departments.update.

post.summary: Move a department under another parent or to the top level; moving under itself or a descendant is rejected. Requires organization.departments.update.
The whole department tree of the current tenant with direct member counts. Requires organization.departments.read.
List up to 20 active users that can be impersonated in a tenant (or the platform), matched by keyword. Requires identity.impersonation.start.
Sign in as another user: opens a separate session for the target and returns tokens carrying the actor claim. Tenant subjects stay in their own tenant. Requires identity.impersonation.start.
End impersonation: revokes the impersonation session and returns tokens for the actor's original session.

delete.summary: Remove users from departments in batch; when a primary membership is removed the next one becomes primary. Requires organization.memberships.delete.

post.summary: Add a user of this tenant to a department, optionally with a position; the first membership of a user becomes the primary one. Requires organization.memberships.create.

put.summary: Update a membership's position, primary flag, employee number, grade, hire date and order. Requires organization.memberships.update.

post.summary: List memberships filtered by department, user, position or primary flag, with user, department and position names. Requires organization.memberships.read.

get.summary: List the permission catalog grantable on the current side. Requires access.permissions.read.

delete.summary: Delete positions in batch; positions still referenced by memberships are rejected item by item. Requires organization.positions.delete.

post.summary: Create a position (code unique within the tenant). Requires organization.positions.create.

put.summary: Update a position's name, order, description and status. Requires organization.positions.update.

post.summary: List positions with paging, keyword, filters and sorting. Requires organization.positions.read.
Change your own password; requires the current password and revokes your other sessions.

delete.summary: Delete roles in batch together with their members and permissions; built-in roles cannot be deleted. Requires access.roles.delete.

post.summary: Create a role on the current side (platform or tenant); the code is unique per side and cannot be changed. Requires access.roles.create.

get.summary: Get a role with its granted permissions and member count. Requires access.roles.read.

put.summary: Update a role's name, description, order and status. Requires access.roles.update.

post.summary: Assign users to a role; users must belong to the role's side. Takes effect at the user's next token refresh. Requires access.roles.assign.
Grant permissions to a role; codes must exist in the catalog and match the role's side. Requires access.roles.grant.
List the members of a role. Requires access.roles.read.
Revoke permissions from a role. Requires access.roles.grant.
Remove users from a role. Takes effect at the user's next token refresh. Requires access.roles.assign.
List the roles a user holds on the current side (platform or tenant). Requires access.roles.read.
List roles of the current side with paging, filters, keyword and sorting. Requires access.roles.read.

delete.summary: Delete tenants in batch and remove them from the directory; tenants that still have users are rejected item by item. Requires tenancy.tenants.delete.

post.summary: Provision a tenant: write the tenant and register it (enabled) in the tenant directory; the administrator is created with tenants.initialize-admin. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenants.create.

get.summary: Get a tenant with its administrator's user name and user count. Requires tenancy.tenants.read.

put.summary: Update a tenant's name, description, expiry and order; the name is mirrored to the directory. Requires tenancy.tenants.update.

post.summary: Create the first administrator of a tenant with every tenant-side permission; the password must be changed at first sign-in. Once per tenant. Requires tenancy.tenants.initialize-admin.
List tenants with paging, filters, keyword and sorting. Requires tenancy.tenants.read.
Tenants the current user can enter (home tenant and memberships, active only) and whether the platform is available; the control center switches with auth.switch-tenant.
Resume suspended tenants in batch. Requires tenancy.tenants.suspend.
Suspend tenants in batch: the directory marks them disabled, their users cannot sign in and calls carrying the tenant are rejected. Requires tenancy.tenants.suspend.

delete.summary: Delete users in batch (soft delete) and revoke their sessions; you cannot delete yourself. Requires identity.users.delete.

post.summary: Create a user: a tenant principal creates one in its own tenant; a platform principal may name the home tenant or create a platform account. Requires identity.users.create.

get.summary: Get a user by ID; tenant principals only see their own tenant. Requires identity.users.read.

put.summary: Update a user's display name, email and phone number. Requires identity.users.update.

post.summary: Set a new password for a user, revoke their sessions and require a change at next login. Requires identity.users.reset-password.
List users with paging, filters, keyword and sorting; tenant principals only see their own tenant. Requires identity.users.read.
Lock users in batch and revoke their sessions; you cannot lock yourself. Requires identity.users.lock.
Unlock users in batch. Requires identity.users.lock.

access.permissions.read.description: View the permission catalog of the current side.

access.roles.assign.description: Assign users to roles and remove them.

access.roles.create.description: Create roles on the current side (platform or tenant).

access.roles.delete.description: Delete roles together with their members and permissions.

access.roles.grant.description: Grant permissions to roles and revoke them.

access.roles.read.description: View roles, their members and their permissions.

access.roles.update.description: Edit role names, descriptions, order and status.

identity.impersonation.start.description: Sign in as another user of the current tenant (platform: any tenant) to troubleshoot on their behalf.

identity.users.create.description: Create users in the current tenant.

identity.users.delete.description: Delete users of the current tenant.

identity.users.lock.description: Lock and unlock users of the current tenant.

identity.users.read.description: View users of the current tenant.

identity.users.reset-password.description: Reset user passwords; the user must change the password at next sign-in.

identity.users.update.description: Edit user profiles of the current tenant.

organization.departments.create.description: Create departments anywhere in the tree.

organization.departments.delete.description: Delete departments that have no children and no members.

organization.departments.read.description: View the department tree and department details.

organization.memberships.read.description: View which users belong to which departments.

organization.memberships.update.description: Change a membership's position, primary flag, employee number, grade and hire date.

organization.positions.delete.description: Delete positions that no membership references.

tenancy.tenant-members.create.description: Let a user whose home tenant is elsewhere enter a tenant.

tenancy.tenant-members.delete.description: Revoke a member's access to a tenant.

tenancy.tenant-members.read.description: View which users may enter a tenant as members.

tenancy.tenants.create.description: Provision a tenant and register it in the tenant directory.

tenancy.tenants.delete.description: Delete tenants without users and remove them from the directory.

tenancy.tenants.initialize-admin.description: Create the first administrator of a tenant with every tenant-side permission.

tenancy.tenants.suspend.description: Suspend and resume tenants; suspended tenants cannot sign in.

tenancy.tenants.update.description: Edit tenant names, descriptions, expiry and order.
